lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical markings exhibit discontinuity, transitioning from solid lines to isolated dash-like segments before reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 3 distinct white spots is visible on the lateral posterior haunch above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align along a 30-degree diagonal vector relative to the horizontal plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a classic lyrate trajectory, diverging laterally from the frontal bone before curving medially and anteriorly at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 2.8 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12 percent of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Proninent white chevron present between the orbital regions; two distinct white spots located on the lower maxillary/mandibular region.
